questiontext.text:
The state equations of an LTIV system is represented by \(\dot{x} = Ax + Bu\). Find the state transition matrix \(\phi(t)\).

Given:

\[ A = \begin{bmatrix} -{@a@} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -{@b@} & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -{@b@} \end{bmatrix}, \quad B = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix} \]

Enter the state transition matrix \(\phi(t)\) as a \(3 \times 3\) matrix:

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The state transition matrix is \(\phi(t) = \mathcal{L}^{-1}\{(sI - A)^{-1}\}\). Note it does not depend on \(B\).

Step 1: Compute \(sI - A\)

\[ [sI - A] = \begin{bmatrix} s+{@a@} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & s+{@b@} & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & s+{@b@} \end{bmatrix} \]

Step 2: Compute the determinant

\[ |sI - A| = (s+{@a@})(s+{@b@})^2 \]

Step 3: Compute the adjugate

\[ \text{Adj}(sI - A) = \begin{bmatrix} (s+{@b@})^2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & (s+{@a@})(s+{@b@}) & (s+{@a@}) \\ 0 & 0 & (s+{@a@})(s+{@b@}) \end{bmatrix} \]

Step 4: Compute \((sI - A)^{-1} = \dfrac{\text{Adj}(sI-A)}{|sI-A|}\)

\[ (sI - A)^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} \dfrac{1}{s+{@a@}} & 0 & 0 \\[8pt] 0 & \dfrac{1}{s+{@b@}} & \dfrac{1}{(s+{@b@})^2} \\[8pt] 0 & 0 & \dfrac{1}{s+{@b@}} \end{bmatrix} \]

Step 5: Take the inverse Laplace transform

Using \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{\dfrac{1}{s+\alpha}\right\} = e^{-\alpha t}\) and \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{\dfrac{1}{(s+\alpha)^2}\right\} = te^{-\alpha t}\):

\[ \therefore \quad \phi(t) = \begin{bmatrix} e^{-{@a@}t} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & e^{-{@b@}t} & te^{-{@b@}t} \\ 0 & 0 & e^{-{@b@}t} \end{bmatrix} \]
